name: North Macedonia
famous_for: Ancient crystalline Lake Ohrid (one of Europe's oldest lakes), historic monasteries, Ottoman Old Bazaar, and statue-filled Skopje.
tourists: Over 1.2M visitors; highlights include Church of St. John at Kaneo, Lake Ohrid boat rides, and Matka Canyon kayaking.
must_know: Lake Ohrid preserves a unique aquatic ecosystem with more than 200 endemic species that evolved over millions of years.
fun_fact: Mother Teresa (Saint Teresa of Calcutta) was born in Skopje in 1910 and spent the first 18 years of her life in the city.
